name: roxmltree

name: xmlparser
input_api: xmlparser::Tokenizer::from(&str) -> Iterator<Item=Result<Token, Error>>; Token::{ElementStart, Attribute, ElementEnd, Text, Cdata}
scope: XML 1.0 UTF-8 document without DOCTYPE tokenized from local text: adapter resolves namespace prefixes and declarations, builds element depth and expanded names, decodes predefined and numeric character references, and reports ordered attributes and text. family: xmlparser 0.13.6 own low-level XML tokenizer; distinct pinned source from roxmltree 0.21.2 internal tokenizer, with documented historical relationship
